$comment: Surfaces fixed in place while still unconverted, under the urgent-fix escape in AGENTS.md.
A debt ledger, not a permit. It obeys the rule every other baseline in this repository obeys:
the only edit is downward. A row leaves by the surface becoming an extension — never because
somebody decided the debt had aged out.
A surface already listed here may not take the escape a second time. One emergency is an
emergency; two is a plan, and a plan does not need an escape hatch.
Each row: the surface, the date, what was urgent, and which file carries the comment at the site.

urgent: The same defect as sessions.ts, on the path that runs without a terminal in
front of anyone. headlessEnv copies process.env wholesale and the account that
is the platform default contributes no variable, so an inherited
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR survived: a headless run and a model-assisted consolidation
executed against whichever login the operator's shell named while the record
said otherwise. The second of those is metered and spends money.
src/main/headless.ts.comment: src/main/headless.ts, in headlessEnv where the account environment is applied
note: Fixed in headlessEnv rather than at its two call sites (headless.ts and
learning-model-assist.ts), so a third caller cannot repeat it — five callers
sharing one defect is how this was found. codex-status.ts is the one caller
still carrying it: its probe allowlist includes CODEX_HOME, so the default
account's status is read from the shell's home rather than its own. That is a
wrong reading and not an execution, nothing runs under it, and it was left for
the conversion rather than spending a third escape on a display bug.
